episodes.title: Pilot

episodes.summary: Jill finds the behavior of Tim's college roommate to be pretty collegiate.

episodes.summary: Tim tries but fails to answer Jill's request for a birthday gift that suits her instead of him.

episodes.title: Luck Be a Taylor Tonight

episodes.title: Al's Fair in Love and War

episodes.summary: Tim and Jill questions their marriage when Tim does poorly on a marriage compatibility test that Jill makes him take.

episodes.title: Dances with Tools

episodes.title: This Joke's for You
episodes.summary: Tim has problems with Randy when he realizes that Randy is becoming an adolescent.

episodes.title: 'Twas the Blight Before Christmas

episodes.title: Reel Men
episodes.summary: Tim and Al have one problem after another when Al buys a Ice Fishing shack and they both go ice fishing.

episodes.title: Room for Change
episodes.summary: Tim decides to separate Brad and Randy when their arguing becomes too loud for his liking.

episodes.title: The Eve of Construction
episodes.summary: Tim and Jill become involved in helping with Habitat For Humanity houses then get into a competition against each other.

episodes.summary: When Tim see's Jill's computer software and literature that shows how a person would look with physical enhancements, she is left feeling undesirable when he has a mans reaction to the software image of her with larger breasts.

episodes.title: Back in the Saddle Shoes Again
episodes.summary: Jill is laid off from work and Tim is less than considerate to her.

episodes.title: Don't Tell Momma
episodes.summary: Tim criticizes Jill when she scratches her car, then has a major mishap with her car involving a crane on a Tool Time shoot site.

episodes.summary: After Harry has a heart attack at the hardware store while Tim is there, Tim starts having problems.

episodes.summary: Tim's brother pays a visit to Tim and reveals that he is thinking about leaving his wife and kids.

episodes.summary: Tim is unable to invest in Harry's Hardware which opens the window for Al to invest and start making changes.

episodes.summary: Jill's speech is accidentally caught on video tape and so is Tim's negative review.

episodes.title: The Route of All Evil
episodes.summary: Brad takes on a paper route, then delivers the news that it is more than he can handle.

episodes.summary: Jill's illness conflicts with the Superbowl party that Tim has planned for months.

episodes.title: Tool Time After Dark (2)
episodes.summary: Tim continues to spend a sleepless night watching tool time clips after overeating.

episodes.title: Sisters and Brothers
episodes.summary: Visiting relatives cause problems for Jill, Tim and Al.

episodes.summary: Tim and Jill must make a parenting decision when one of the boys is accused of stealing a Swiss army knife from the hardware store.

episodes.title: Wilson's Girlfriend
episodes.summary: Jill plays matchmaker and introduces their next door neighbor Wilson to one of her professors.

episodes.summary: Jill's amateur psychology creates problems for Tim's car repair buddy, meanwhile Wilson practices fencing in the back yard. Al turtle sits for his mother.

episodes.summary: Brad throws a Halloween party at home without permission while Tim, Jill and Al are at a tv Awards ceremony.

episodes.title: The Look

episodes.title: Room Without A View

episodes.title: Doctor in the House
episodes.summary: Jill is not thrilled when Tim learns he will be receiving a honorary doctorate from the college that both Jill and him attended.

episodes.title: That's My Momma
episodes.summary: Tim is uncomfortable discussing personal matters with his visiting mother.

episodes.title: 'Twas The Flight Before Christmas
episodes.summary: Tim and Al fret over being stranded in a small-town airport on Christmas Eve.

episodes.summary: Tool Time does a special salute to the Armed Forces and Tim is given the chance to drive a tank and doesn't do so well.

episodes.summary: Tim becomes extremely nervous when Jill wants him to get a vasectomy.

episodes.summary: Tim offers Harry advice after Delores decides to work at the hardware store. Alan Jackson stars on 'Tool Time' and sings 'Mercury Blues'.

episodes.summary: Bad comes home with a new style of haircut that Tim absolutely hates; Jill rehearses "Romeo And Juliet" with Randy.

episodes.summary: Wilson takes over as director of the Romeo and Juliet play that the school is putting and and it goes to his head.

episodes.summary: When Tim's boss Bud tells the tale of his impending divorce, Tim ends up going to a couples workshop with Jill.

episodes.title: Jill And Her Sisters

episodes.title: Workin' Man Blues

episodes.title: The Flirting Game
episodes.summary: After a pretty female door to door saleslady gets Tim to buy a large quantity of her product by flirting with him, Jill starts teasing him about the flirting being the reason he made the purchase. Jill then catches herself using the same methods to get what she wants.

episodes.title: The Karate Kid Returns
episodes.summary: Tim discovers that Wilson has some very famous relatives. Mark saves Randy from a bully after taking Karate classes.

episodes.title: Totally Tool Time

episodes.title: A Funny Valentine
episodes.summary: Tim has a encounter with a singer who hints that she had an affair with Tim's father; Tim finally buy's Jill a nice Valentines day present early and forgets where he hid it.

episodes.title: Wilson's World
episodes.summary: Wilson tries to become more 'Normal' when he is criticized for his artistic self expression at a local improv club. Meanwhile on Tool Time Tim and Al have a invent food off.

episodes.title: Something Old, Something Blue
episodes.summary: Al reveals a secret to Tim and the guys before his wedding to Ilene. Tim talks about a Man's Wedding and cake on 'Tool Time'.

episodes.title: Communication Breakdown
episodes.summary: Tim and Jill ponder their relationships with the boys when they witness a blowup between Harry and his son.

episodes.title: My Son, The Driver

episodes.title: Insult to Injury

episodes.title: Family Un-Ties

episodes.title: The Feminine Mistake
episodes.summary: 'Tool Time' gets approval to create a 3-D effects show; Jill wants Tim to act more like an equal when she discovers that Brad is having his girlfriend do his laundry and clean his room.

episodes.title: Taps
episodes.summary: Tim receives a phone call while Jill is out and has to tell Jill that a family member has passed away. The tragedy causes Jill to become wroth with guilt.

episodes.title: The Kiss And The Kiss-Off
episodes.summary: Tim asks former 'Tool Time' girl Lisa to return to the show temporarily but neglects to consult with Heidi.

episodes.title: Quest For Fire
episodes.summary: The Taylors look forward to their annual summer getaway, each for different reasons.

episodes.title: Clash of the Taylors
episodes.summary: When Randy writes an article for the school paper disclosing Binford Tools poor environmental record, Tim feels flabbergasted.

episodes.title: Room at the Top
episodes.summary: Jill declines Tim's offer to build her a quiet at-home work space, and that offends him.

episodes.title: Pump You Up
episodes.summary: Tim becomes Brad's personal trainer after a college expresses interest in giving him a sports scholarship.

episodes.title: A Night to Dismember
episodes.summary: The weird subject matter of Mark's Halloween horror film has Tim and Jill worried; Tim builds a hot rod Jack-O-Lantern; Al has problems after finding out Ilene has become engaged again.

episodes.title: The Niece
episodes.summary: Much to Tim's chagrin, Wilson would rather spend time with his niece than restore the Studebaker she gave him.

episodes.title: Jill's Passion
episodes.summary: Jill is asked out on a date and realizes her 18-year marriage has lost some spark and romance.

episodes.title: Losing My Religion
episodes.summary: Randy questions God's existence, which prompts Tim to visit the Rev. Mike.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: The Taylor's spend Thanksgiving at a Detroit Lions game with a Hollywood producer.

episodes.title: The Dating Game

episodes.summary: Jill is upset when her recently widowed mother asks if she can invite a male friend over with her for Christmas.

episodes.title: An Older Woman

episodes.title: Tim 'The Landlord' Taylor
episodes.summary: Tim becomes a landlord when he decides to rent their second house to Al, who gets frustrated with Tim and becomes a stickler with the clauses in the lease. Brad and Randy buy the same shirt.

episodes.title: Say Goodnight, Gracie
episodes.summary: Tim spends a pleasant time with his four year old niece and decides that having another child would be good.

episodes.title: What a Drag
episodes.summary: A accident in Tim's backyard causes Tim to discover a hidden bag of pot. Tim and Jill then try to figure out who's it is and how to handle the situation.

episodes.title: Taking Jill For Granite
episodes.summary: A trust issue arises when the guy Jill previously met at the gym and had dreams about becomes Tim's new granite guy and is working on installing new counter tops in the Taylor's home.

episodes.title: Futile Attraction
episodes.summary: Tim suspects that Al and Heidi are having an affair; Pro golfer Payne Stewart visits 'Tool Time' and Tim brings out a souped up golf club. Meanwhile Jill is sick with the flu.

episodes.title: Desperately Seeking Willow
episodes.summary: Jill fears the worst when Wilson's niece Willow who is staying with them does not come home one night; 'Tool Time' celebrates St. Patrick's Day.

episodes.title: The Write Stuff
episodes.summary: Randy becomes upset when Brad gets a sports gossip column in the school paper and gets more attention than his articles do.

episodes.title: The Son Also Mooches
episodes.summary: Tim worries that his mother will lose her investment in his brother Jeff's risky new business venture. Jill has trouble reading and has to get glasses.

episodes.title: Believe It Or Not
episodes.summary: Tim jokingly shares a conversation that Wilson told him and thought would be between just Tim and him.

episodes.title: Rebel Without Night Driving Privileges
episodes.summary: Randy gets his drivers license and Jill decides he is not driving at night, Tim is bit by a Rat on 'Tool Time' and Al meets Trudy for the first time.

episodes.title: Tool-Thousand-One: A Space Odyssey
episodes.summary: Tim and Al compete to be chosen to operate a Binford tool in space; Mark tries to impress a girl.

episodes.title: From Top To Bottom
episodes.summary: Jill makes embarrassing comments about Tim while being interviewed on a local talk show.

episodes.title: Whitewater
episodes.summary: Tim gets excited about spending his birthday watching a NASCAR race until Jill surprises him with a river rafting trip.

episodes.title: Adios
episodes.summary: Randy must make a decision when he is accepted into a yearlong work-study program in Costa Rica.

episodes.title: All In The Family
episodes.summary: Tim and Jill's alone time to get more romantic is interrupted when Jill's sister arrives unexpectedly for a visit.

episodes.title: Taylor Got Game
episodes.summary: Brad tries to convince his parents to let him play professional soccer in Europe instead of going to College. Tool Time does Wake ups in a college dorm.

episodes.title: Al's Fair Lady
episodes.summary: Tim does not understand why Al has trouble accepting extravagant gifts from his new girlfriend Trudy. 'Tool Time' sends out the Tool Van.

episodes.title: Bewitched
episodes.summary: Tim becomes a murder suspect after Wilson disappears following a Halloween party.

episodes.title: Not-So-Great Scott
episodes.summary: Tim accidentally tells Heidi that her husband is seeing one of Jill's patients after Jill reveals the information to him.

episodes.title: Tim's First Car
episodes.summary: When Tim discovers his first car at a junkyard, he decides that he wants to buy it and fix it back up.

episodes.title: Mr. Likeable
episodes.summary: Tim has trouble convincing everyone that he is happy for Al, who gets a role in a TV movie with Morgan Fairchild.

episodes.title: Thanks, But No Thanks
episodes.summary: Tim invites his brother, Marty, who has separated from his wife and twin daughters to move into the Taylor household.

episodes.title: Home for the Holidays
episodes.summary: Randy surprises the family when he returns home for Christmas; Tim and Al compete in the neighborhood lighting contest.

episodes.title: Ploys for Tots
episodes.summary: Tim gives his newly divorced brother Marty advice regarding the twins and their tantrums.

episodes.title: Chop Shop 'Til You Drop
episodes.summary: Tim and Al go under cover to find the thieves of Brad's new car.

episodes.title: Home Alone
episodes.summary: When Tim stays at home by himself in order to work on writing his book, he dreams of being an author and pop icon.

episodes.title: Knee Deep
episodes.summary: Brad blames Tim when he injures his knee during a taping of 'Tool Time' at home. Penn & Teller guest stars on 'Tool Time'.

episodes.title: Mark's Big Break
episodes.summary: Suspicious Tim did not like his 'Tool Time' video so Mark makes him another one, complete with a dance number set to 'Greased Lightning'.

episodes.title: Love's Labour Lost (1)
episodes.summary: The Taylor's lives come to a halt when Jill is told she might need a hysterectomy; 'Tool Time' does ski maintenance.

episodes.title: Love's Labour Lost (2)
episodes.summary: Jill's mother visits to help Jill and Tim cope with the emotional highs and lows of Jill's surgery.

episodes.title: Neighbours
episodes.summary: Wilson wins a large sum of money at a hockey game while with Tim and Brad and he decides to build a greenhouse which annoys Tim.

episodes.title: A Hardware Habit To Break
episodes.summary: Tim decides to buy the hardware store from Harry, but wonders what he is doing wrong when it stops making money.

episodes.title: Loose Lips And Freudian Slips
episodes.summary: Jill's professor overhears her insult him while at Mark's film presentation, which puts her at odds with the thesis committee. 'Tool Time' does a salute to men with a Heidi hosting a Chili making special.

episodes.title: Trouble-A-Bruin
episodes.summary: Brad decides to risk re-injuring his knee in order to try out for a soccer scholarship, Binford cracks down even more on what can be done on 'Tool Time' and takes all non-Binford tools away from the set.

episodes.title: Dead Weight
episodes.summary: TIm and Jill comfort Al when his mother dies; a new producer makes Tim's job at 'Tool Time' very unpleasant.

episodes.title: The Long And Winding Road (1)
episodes.summary: Many changes are on the way for the Taylor's, starting with Tim's frustration with his new producer.

episodes.title: The Long And Winding Road (2)
episodes.summary: Tim and Jill need to decide their future and reminisce about the past eight years; Al prepares to get married in the Taylor's backyard.

episodes.title: The Long And Winding Road (3)
episodes.summary: Tim and Jill share a touching moment at Al's wedding; outtakes from the series eight seasons.
